item.title: github: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air. The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and lets you delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results in the IDE.

  • Source: GitHub
